arxiv-1809-01791.title: MDCN: Multi-Scale, Deep Inception Convolutional Neural Networks for Efficient Object Detection
arxiv-1809-01791.creator: Wenchi Ma † , Yuanwei Wu † , Zongbo Wang ‡ , Guanghui Wang †
arxiv-1809-01791.description: Abstract Object detection in challenging situations such as scale variation, occlusion, and truncation depends not only on feature details but also on contextual information. Most previous networks emphasize too much on detailed feature extraction through deeper and wider networks, which may enhance the accuracy of object detection to certain extent.

arxiv-2008-05254.description: Abstract Abstract The geometrically rigorous nonlinear analysis of elastic shells is considered in the context of finite, but small, strain theory. The research is focused on the introduction of the full shell metric and examination of its influence on the nonlinear structural response.

arxiv-2210-06610.title: A Neural Mean Embedding Approach for Back-door and Front-door Adjustment
arxiv-2210-06610.creator: Liyuan Xu, Arthur Gretton
arxiv-2210-06610.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Liyuan Xu, Arthur Gretton. We consider the estimation of average and counterfactual treatment effects, under two settings: back-door adjustment and front-door adjustment . The goal in both cases is to recover the treatment effect without having an access to a hidden confounder. This objective is attained by first estimating the conditional mean of the desired outcome variable given relevant covariates (the “first stage” regression), and then taking the (conditional) expectation of this function as a “second stage” procedure.

arxiv-2303-00020.description: Abstract Accretion disks around compact objects are expected to enter an unstable phase at high luminosity [ 1 ] . One instability may occur when the radiation pressure generated by accretion modifies the disk viscosity, resulting in the cyclic depletion and refilling of the inner disk on short timescales [ 2 ] .

pmc-10650117.title: The Link between Periodontal Disease and Asthma: How Do These Two Diseases Affect Each Other?
pmc-10650117.creator: Hiroyuki Tamiya, Masanobu Abe, Takahide Nagase, Akihisa Mitani
pmc-10650117.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A growing body of evidence suggests that the effects of poor oral hygiene extend beyond the oral cavity and are associated with a variety of systemic diseases, including asthma. Asthma, which results in symptoms of cough, wheezing, and dyspnoea, and is characterized by airflow limitation with variability and (partial or complete) reversibility, is amongst the most prevalent respiratory diseases with approximately 262 million patients worldwide, and its prevalence and disease burden is on the increase.

pmc-11292301.creator: Xin Na, Lin Li, Dongmei Liu, Jiaqi He, Ling Zhang, Yiping Zhou
pmc-11292301.description: Ferroptosis inducers (FIN) have a key role in cancer therapy and provide novel and innovative treatment strategies. pmc-11296886.creator: Fei Song, Bo Hu, Xiao‐Liang Liang, Jian‐Wen Cheng, Cheng‐Gui Wang, Peng‐Xiang Wang, Tian‐Lun Wang, Peng‐Ju Tang, Hai‐Xiang Sun, Wei Guo, Jian Zhou, Jia Fan, Zhong Chen, Xin‐Rong Yang
pmc-11296886.description: BackgroundThe therapeutic potential of immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) extends across various cancers; however, its effectiveness in treating hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is frequently curtailed by both inherent and developed resistance.ObjectiveThis research explored the effectiveness of integrating anlotinib (a broad‐spectrum tyrosine kinase inhibitor) with programmed death‐1 (PD‐1) blockade and offers mechanistic insights into more effective strategies for treating HCC.

pmc-11356979.creator: Zhao-Min Liu, Yu-Ming Chen, Chao-Gang Chen, Cheng Wang, Min-Min Li, Yu-Biao Guo
pmc-11356979.description: Research on dietary fatty acids (FAs) and lung health has reported skeptical findings. This study aims to examine the causal relationship between circulating FAs and Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) onset and exacerbation, using a two-sample Mendelian Randomization (MR) analysis. Strong and independent genetic variants of FAs were obtained from the UK Biobank of European ancestry.

pmc-13340930.description: Nipah virus (NiV) poses a significant public health threat due to its high mortality rate and the absence of approved treatments. Nonetheless, the host–virus interactions underlying its pathogenesis remain poorly understood. Here, we identified the 5-methylcytosine (m5C) methyltransferase NSUN2 as a critical host factor hijacked by NiV to facilitate replication via dual mechanisms.

pmc-13446087.title: Region- and Layer-Specific Glutamatergic Synapse Development in the Nascent Cortical Hierarchy

pmc-13446087.description: Neocortical synapses are highly dynamic during brain development, undergoing formation, elimination, and maturation before acquiring properties that support adult cognition. Individual neocortical regions develop at different ages, and individual layers within these regions contain distinct neuronal subtypes that process unique patterns of local and long-range synaptic input.

pmc-13550832.title: Dynamic Vascular Spatiotemporal Heterogeneity on Multiphase CT for Preoperative Prediction of Microvascular Invasion in Hepatocellular Carcinoma
pmc-13550832.creator: Shucheng Yang, Meng Liu, Yongjie Zhou, Jinhong Zhao, Yongming Tan, Weijia Wang
pmc-13550832.description: PurposeMicrovascular invasion (MVI) is an important determinant of postoperative recurrence in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) but is usually confirmed only after surgery. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a multiphase CT framework integrating dynamic vascular trajectory, spatial intratumoral heterogeneity, and deep imaging features for preoperative MVI prediction and exploratory prognostic stratification.
